rows.en: ＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿００１Hi, Cousin!￥Hehe, I came to visit!
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿００２I mean, I never get to see you￥on our days off.
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿００３That meeting really surprised￥me! You're amazing, Cousin! When￥did you start working so hard?
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿００４I wonder... does rivalry with￥the others have something to do￥with it, at least a little?
Not really, no.
Maybe it does, a bit.
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿００５Really?￥Then it's just a pure drive￥to improve yourself!
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿００６That's my cousin!
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿００７But... don't push yourself so￥hard that you get sick, okay?
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿００８Yeah, I get it. I mean, exam￥results are always announced in￥front of everyone...
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿００９If there's a first place,￥then... there's always gotta be￥a last place, too.＝＠１３６＿０１０I'd be lying if I said I didn't￥feel any rivalry.
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿０１１I can't just stand on the￥sidelines cheering you on while￥you work hard, huh?
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿０１２After all, I'm one of the￥candidates too.
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿０１３So... I've gotta work hard too,￥so you can be proud of me,￥Cousin!
That's the spirit!
Talk is cheap, you know.
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿０１４Yeah! I'm gonna work so hard,￥I'll surprise even you, Cousin!
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿０１５R-right! I'll do my best!
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿０１６I don't want to lose to the￥others either, you know!
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿０１７If I don't try hard, there's no￥point in being here! Right?
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿０１８Sorry for barging in on your￥day off.＝＠１３６＿０１９But talking with you got me￥all fired up!
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿０２０I feel like I can give training￥my all again starting tomorrow!
＊Kaname＊＠１３６＿０２１See you later!!
